=== app/app.go ===
package app

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/m/core"
)

// Run prints things.
func Run() {
	w := core.Widget{N: 1}
	fmt.Println(core.Foo(), core.Util(), w.Double())
}

=== app/app_test.go ===
package app

import "testing"

func TestRun(t *testing.T) { Run() }

=== core/lib.go ===
package core

// Foo returns a greeting.
func Foo() string { return helper() + Util() }

func helper() string { return "hi" }

=== core/lib_test.go ===
package core

import "testing"

func TestFoo(t *testing.T) {
	if Foo() == "" || helper() == "" {
		t.Fatal("empty")
	}
}

=== core/util.go ===
package core

import "strings"

// Util upper-cases.
func Util() string { return strings.ToUpper("x") }

// Widget doubles.
type Widget struct{ N int }

func (w Widget) Double() int { return w.N * 2 }

=== core/util_test.go ===
package core_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/core"
)

func TestUtil(t *testing.T) {
	if core.Util() != "X" || (core.Widget{N: 2}).Double() != 4 {
		t.Fatal("bad")
	}
}
